apps.name: Atlasbound
apps.subtitle: Discover the world, one hex at a time
apps.localizedDescription:
Atlasbound is a location-based exploration RPG for iPhone.

• Discover hexagonal tiles as you walk, run, cycle, or drive
• Earn familiarity XP when revisiting tiles
• Reveal width follows activity type (15 / 20 / 25 m grids)
• Frontier expeditions, Pinpoint guessing, and Atlas Stats
• All progress stored on-device

privacy.name: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Atlasbound uses your location while recording an activity to discover map tiles along your route.

privacy.name: NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription
privacy.usageDescription: Atlasbound can continue recording your route in the background so driving and walking stay passive—no phone interaction required while moving. Location is used only for tile discovery on your device.
